Holdings_Audit.primary_kpi_summary: Utilisation 79.02% FY26 / ~86% Jun-26 PASS; yield 2.12%/month FY26, 2.29% India and 4.10% Saudi Jun-26 PASS; order book Rs 1,253 cr vs FY27 revenue guidance Rs 1,400-1,500 cr (equal to 84-90% of full-year guided revenue) PASS; debtor days group 116, Saudi 201 vs <75 bar FAIL
Holdings_Audit.moat_description: Largest crane rental fleet in India (5th largest globally) with high-capacity cranes, 15 depots, 175 acres of freehold parking land, ICRA A+ (Stable) balance sheet and 40-45% repeat business; competitive pricing power limited by smaller rivals
Holdings_Audit.invalidation_condition: Close below Rs 317 (1 ATR under the 338.45 swing low) = exit all 890 shares (REPLACE_UNDERPERFORMER); also Sep-26 results with group debtor days >120, core crane margin <45% or EBITDA <Rs 105 cr. Debtor days 105-120 (today 116) = hold, no add
Holdings_Audit.investment_thesis: The rental business is busy (utilisation ~86%, India yield 2.29%/month, order book Rs 1,253 cr = 84-90% of full-year guided revenue) and the stock at 14.6x trailing profit (13.4x our FY27E EPS of 25.7) versus a 24.6x 3Y median prices in about 3% growth against guided EBITDA growth of 22-34%. Quality is slipping: profit flat since FY24 (Rs 188 cr to Rs 184 cr), margin 63% to 37%, unbilled work doubled, debt +54%, FCF -Rs 129 cr in FY26. The thesis hinges on receivable days reversing.
Holdings_Audit.summary_rationale: KEEP_COMPOUNDING in its narrow sense (hold, do not add): no REPLACE rule is met (close 344.95 above stop 317, 3/4 KPIs, no red line) and no add rule is met (gate PARTIAL, NO_MOMENTUM, RSI 24.5, support untested, weight 6.71% already at the 6.5% TIER_2 cap). Exit on a close below 317; ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP only after Test C passes (RSI>35, higher low above 338.45, close above 20DMA 414.80 on volume). Fundamental bear downside with base costs held is about -20.9% (Rs 273); stop-executed loss is about -8.1%.
